mustReport.detail: Every frame appears once per interface within 1 ms

notes: Hard false-positive trap for the frozen flow key: 5-tuple + VLAN + INTERFACE means ifaceId 0 and 1 are distinct flows and duplicates must never surface as retransmissions.
description: pcapng with two IDBs; the same session captured on both interfaces (SPAN duplication).
tsharkCrossReference: tshark 4.6 reports 'TCP Retransmission' on frames 2 and 4 and 'TCP Dup ACK' on frame 6 because its flow key ignores the capture interface. Our frozen flow key includes ifaceId, so these MUST NOT be reported as retransmissions. Deliberate divergence from Wireshark.
